title: The Orphan Gods

sourceEvidence.locator: Iri wakes alone inside a sealed pedagogical alve
sourceEvidence.excerpt: Iri wakes alone inside a sealed pedagogical alve. The network is silent, food is withheld, and the only available exit leads into a three-dimensional simulation populated by human “masks.” She can enter minds, alter impulses, redirect events, and observe branching consequences. Her first compassionate intervention saves a child and mother but produces no useful yield. A destructive change that kills others brings the energy her body needs to remain coherent.
